name: impact-checksum-grammar-sweep
description: IMPACT emulator sweep for result-row prefix, checksum width, delimiter, and line-ending grammar.
notes: Generated from result-timing.csv; no command in this profile opens COM5.
Protocol prelude rules, when present, are trace-derived responses before the first #rd.
Rows include the leading # and the selected line ending.
Clamped suspected fields from rejected row: 2=13.354, 8=62.237, 12=10.276, 15=62.237.
Changed field 6 from 65.430 to 65.420 to move checksum from 100 to 099.
After ?, recovery rows intentionally omit the leading # because real ARL reject-loop repeats the row body without #.
Checksum sweep includes es 248 -> # because IMPACT may end a sample after recovery/two displayed rows.
